convert_yolos_checkpoint: convert a YOLOS checkpoint from the original repository to a Hugging Face PyTorch model
get_yolos_config: get a YolosConfig with architecture parameters for a specified YOLOS model variant
convert_state_dict: convert an original YOLOS state dict to Hugging Face YOLOS model state dict format
rename_key: rename a YOLOS checkpoint key to the corresponding Hugging Face YOLOS model key
read_in_q_k_v: split a combined qkv weight matrix into separate query, key, and value tensors per encoder layer
